title: WSUS to Windows Update for Business Patch Modernization
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (migration off WSUS to cloud patching; coexistence and cutover with existing on-prem update infrastructure).
version_directive: +1 — fork derived from windows-updates-for-business (WUFB); the original WUfB product remains live and untouched. This product is the WSUS-retirement migration angle.
hook: Retire WSUS — move Windows patching to Windows Update for Business, managed from Intune
problem: WSUS is a maintenance tax: a server to patch and back up, a content store that bloats and corrupts, declined-update cleanup, and approvals that only reach devices on the corporate network. Remote machines simply fall behind. This solution gives you a clean migration off WSUS to Windows Update for Business, managed through Intune: update rings, feature/quality deferrals, deadlines, and Delivery Optimization — so devices patch from Microsoft wherever they are, and you can decommission the WSUS servers.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — why WSUS is a liability, how Windows Update for Business and Intune update rings replace it, feature/quality update deferrals and deadlines, Delivery Optimization, and the coexistence-then-cutover plan to retire WSUS.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra-joined or hybrid devices, removing conflicting WSUS/GPO update policy, internet/Delivery Optimization reachability, ring design) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory current WSUS approvals and update policy, design rings, create Windows Update for Business ring policies in Intune, remove conflicting WSUS/GPO settings, validate devices scan against Microsoft, decommission WSUS, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — update-configuration discovery (detect WSUS/GPO conflicts), patch-compliance validation, a fleet patch-status and ring report, safe remediation (clear WSUS pointers), and an update-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A clean migration off WSUS to Windows Update for Business, managed from Intune — update rings, deferrals, deadlines, and Delivery Optimization — so devices patch from Microsoft anywhere and the WSUS servers retire. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A clean migration off WSUS to Windows Update for Business, managed from Intune — update rings, deferrals, deadlines, Delivery Optimization — so devices patch anywhere and WSUS retires.

bottom_line: Windows patching modernized off WSUS — devices updating from Microsoft via Intune update rings wherever they are, conflicts removed, and the WSUS servers decommissioned — proven on a pilot before you scale.
